description_en: Queries the hybrid cloud SDK servers that are managed by a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-sdk-servers --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-i7m20000b --ip '1.0.01。' --host-name online-000wwq --cluster-name testcluster --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHybridCloudSdkServers

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the hybrid cloud SDK server that you want to query
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The hostname of the hybrid cloud SDK server that you want to query
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the hybrid cloud cluster that you want to query
parameters.name: cluster_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

SdkServers.description_en: The information about the hybrid cloud SDK servers

ClusterName.description_en: The name of the hybrid cloud cluster to which the SDK server belongs

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the hybrid cloud SDK server was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds

HostName.description_en: The hostname of the hybrid cloud SDK server

Ip.description_en: The IP address of the hybrid cloud SDK server

Mid.description_en: The ID of the SDK server

ProtectionGroupAddress.description_en: The address of the protection group associated with the SDK server

PullinStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether traffic redirection is enabled. Valid values:

on: Traffic redirection is enabled.

off: Traffic redirection is disabled
PullinStatus.description_zh:
引流状态。取值范围如下：
on: 开启
off: 关闭

Status.description_en: The status of the hybrid cloud SDK server

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the hybrid cloud SDK server was last updated. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of hybrid cloud SDK servers returned
